what_it_does: Kaynes Technology India Limited is a vertically integrated Electronic System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) enterprise. It provides embedded design, OEM/ODM manufacturing, semiconductor packaging (OSAT), and advanced PCB solutions to global and domestic customers across automotive, aerospace, defence, industrial, and medical sectors.
other_facts: Order book stood at ₹83,663 Mn as of 31 March 2026.
Debt-to-equity ratio was maintained at approximately 0.19 times in FY26.
August Electronics in Canada generated ₹2,055 Mn in FY2025-26 revenue.
